words: If it was intended in said decisions to lay down a rule that recovery of damages could not be had by the owner unless the baggage or luggage was intended for the personal use of a passenger while traveling, ... then we disapprove and refuse to follow such rule.
note: conditional disapproval; X also distinguished on facts
